crossRefs.note: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

translations.web: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
translations.bsb: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,
translations.kjv: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
translations.asv: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,
